{{Quote|Not my finest performance, but serviceable.|Watcher One, on his deception|<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|campaign of vengeance]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his son, [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], a '''battle''' occurred in one of the brilliant [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]]'s [[Brell Sediment laboratory|laboratories]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. A [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] attacked the [[Imperial soldier]]s occupying the facility in an effort to locate Godera and extract him from Taris, but an elaborate ploy by [[Watcher One]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] allowed the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[operative]] to escape with Godera while the Knight battled the remaining Imperials. While Watcher One ferried Godera away to [[Imperial Intelligence Outpost|his base]], his operatives tried to deceive the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] into believing that Godera was dead, but Godera's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] assistant [[RE-M0]] proved otherwise. Their ruse exposed, the Imperials attacked the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and, after the battle, Watcher One made a deal with the victorious Jedi to secure [[Time/Legends|time]] to interrogate Godera for his [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] knowledge.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Watcher One reprogrammed this facility's tracking relays. He traced Doctor Godera's encrypted bioscan to its present location.|RE-M0|<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] declared a [[Desolator crisis|personal war]] on the Republic for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], at the hands of a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]]. Seizing control of a number of Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]], Angral also dispatched [[Watcher One]], an [[operative]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to capture [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]], a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who had gone into exile there. When Watcher One learned that the same [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had killed Tarnis had arrived on the planet [[Mission to Taris (Desolator crisis)|in search of Godera]], he was forced to accelerate his efforts: using the equipment at [[Resettlement Zone laboratory|one of Godera's laboratories]], Watcher One tracked the doctor's bioscan to [[Brell Sediment laboratory|another lab]] in the region known as the [[Brell Sediment]]. Watcher One then destroyed the facility's [[Computer/Legends|computer]] to prevent the Knight from doing the same, and he [[Battle in the Resettlement Zone laboratory|left a group]] of [[Imperial soldier]]s behind as he departed for the Brell Sediment to capture Godera.<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Stand down, Jedi. I'm afraid we both lose this contest. Doctor Godera killed himself rather than be captured. It's a tragic loss.|"Watcher One"|<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />}}
[[File:Godera_deception.png|thumb|left|200px|"Watcher One" tries to barter with the Knight.]]
A contingent of [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] under Watcher One's command attacked the laboratory in the Brell Sediment, securing the facility, and they captured Godera in the facility's main chamber and knocked him unconscious. At the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;with the help of Godera's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] assistant [[RE-M0]]&mdash;repaired the first lab's computer and [[tracking relay]]s, allowing the Knight and a companion to locate Godera at the Brell Sediment lab. Watcher One was preparing to extract the scientist and return to his base when he was alerted to the impending arrival of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], so he set up a trap: an Imperial [[Shadow Captain]], donning a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] to appear as Watcher One, and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of stealth Shadow Commandos waited in the main lab with a corpse that was disguised as Godera. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gerrard]]'s forces secured the rest of the facility while Watcher One donned a holoprojector that disguised him as a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]].<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />

Watcher One and an unconscious Godera met the Knight at the facility's entrance, where the operative&mdash;posing as "Kulaa"&mdash;claimed that he and the other man were two of Godera's assistants. Stating that his fellow assistant had been injured in the Imperial attack on the facility, Watcher One deceived the Knight into letting him leave with the unconscious scientist. The Knight and a companion, meanwhile, headed deeper into the facility and fought through the Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] within to reach the main chamber. However, the Knight was dismayed to find "Doctor Godera" lying dead at the [[Limb/Legends|feet]] of two Imperial [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] and "Watcher One," who claimed that the scientist had killed himself rather than face interrogation.<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />

"Watcher One" offered a cessation of hostilities and promised to leave Taris, but his conversation with the Knight was interrupted by the arrival of RE-M0: The droid had run a second trace on Godera's location not long after the Knight had left for the Brell Sediment lab, and his trace had confirmed that Godera was still alive and elsewhere. The ruse exposed, the Shadow Captain cursed and shot RE-M0 with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] before he deactivated the holoprojector, and his commandos opened fire on the Knight. In the resultant fight, the Jedi and the Knight's companion emerged victorious, and Watcher One&mdash;who had reached his base in the ruins of an [[Transport Station 5|old transport station]]&mdash;contacted the Jedi via the facility's communications terminal.<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Hexagon_transformation.png|thumb|right|160px|The real Watcher One removes his disguise.]]
{{Quote|Give me time to administer truth serum to Doctor Godera. Once he reveals his secrets, he's yours. We'll both have what we want.|Watcher One|<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />}}
{{GameLS}}
Explaining the deception, the operative forestalled any response by the Knight by informing the Jedi of a more pressing threat: a [[Rora Seake|Sith assassin]] was on her way to eliminate a [[Lake Brell colony|nearby Republic colony]]. In exchange for time to interrogate the scientist, Watcher One gave the Knight the location of the colony, and the Jedi was able to [[Duel in the Lake Brell colony bunker|stop]] the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] from killing the colonists.<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" /> The Knight then tracked down Watcher One and rescued Godera, but the operative was able to interrogate the scientist on his knowledge of superweapon technology and send his intelligence to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Angral.<ref name="The Rescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Rescue|Taris}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Brell Sediment facility first appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "Catching Up With Watcher One" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The mission ends with Watcher One making a deal for time with the player,<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" /> which depends on the player's alignment. [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light-side]] players are told about the assassin, while [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] players are informed about a deal for Jedi artifacts that is being conducted between a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] nearby. Players can also ignore Watcher One's offer for opposite alignment points,<ref name="A More Immediate Concern" /> but as the Jedi Knight is a light-side player, the Knight is assumed to have rescued the colonists.<ref name="Alignment">[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-class characters in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' are assumed to follow the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment.</ref>
